column1: # Ninja tools and weapons. Registered by Shinobi Combat; combat stats live in the combat session's table, keyed by these ids.
# Columns (every catalogue file): id, name, category, group, rank, slice, stack, price, sources, use, gift, art, props.
# See tools/items/items.py for what each column means. "-" is empty.

column10: use
Blunt training kunai: combo strikes and throws at the Academy posts; never draws blood on a spar
Blunt wooden-edged stars for target practice
The shinobi's knife: combo weapon in hand, right click throws it like a trident and it can be picked up again
A bandit's pitted blade. Throws badly; the forge melts it down to scrap steel
Four-point throwing star; fast, stackable, three at once from Genin
A folding giant shuriken that arcs back toward you
Steel needles: little damage, but they carry a coating and pin a nerve point
A pouch of iron spikes scattered behind you; slows and hurts pursuers
A coil of thin steel wire: a trip trap between two posts, or binding
Bursts into thick smoke: blinds, and mobs lose their target
An Academy prank: a cloud nobody wants to stand in; residents complain
A blinding flash; enemies facing it are stunned for a moment
A simple seal: closes a box or door for a quest; on an enemy it stops chakra recovery for a few seconds
An explosive tag: stick it to a surface or a kunai; hurts entities, never blocks
Five tags on one string that go off in a row
Four tags raise a short-lived barrier entity
Pressed onto a foe it seals their chakra for a few seconds
A wooden practice sword for the Gekko dojo's forms
A short blade with a longer reach than a kunai; the combo's third strike cuts deep
Steel tekko for taijutsu: empty-hand combos hit a little harder
A chain with a weight on each end: wraps a target's legs from mid range
A long staff with 4.5 blocks of reach that uses the combo system
A straight sword for kenjutsu
A sickle on a long chain: hook, pull and strike
A gate guard's flanged mace: slow, and it staggers through a block
An iron-ribbed folding fan: parries well, and carries wind techniques further
A fan as tall as you are; its swings throw wind
Paired trench knives of chakra metal that lengthen with wind chakra
A kunai forged from chakra metal: it carries your nature's chakra
The Sarutobi's long staff, given by the clan to its own; the clan staff of the clan technique
The Hatake tanto whose combo finisher is a lightning dash
A heavier four-armed star with hooked blades: slower, but it cuts deeper
A curved long sword: the kenjutsu route's blade
The Namiashi's black-lacquered blade, given by the clan to its own
Cloth fist wraps for taijutsu: no weapon, a little sturdier fists
